text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Today I w-won't be following from behind anymore.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I've admired Opera O for so long. And with your gracious help, Trainer, I'm finally here!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hear ye, hear ye! Allow me to make an introduction, for at this Takarazuka Kinen, a knight will be stationed by my side.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: She is here! Come hither, Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, I'm coming!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While nervous, her footsteps are nothing light. Firm and assured, step after step, she makes her way over…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She shakes while standing beside T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: (I'll become Opera O's support, and we'll run together. Now, and forever…)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: (If I get this right, I know I'll shine bright, just like Opera O!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: (And if I do shine… just maybe, I'll have a chance against the Ultimate Generation…)

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Doto, you've done well to come this far.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for you, ever since that autumn day—an affair dating back to last year, now six months past.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Fall… last year? What… happened?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Dear me, has it escaped your memory? It was the day Ayabe took her leave from racing.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Be well, Ayabe. I am certain that for you, this is but a small obstacle in a greater path. However…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: This means our fight with the generation prior—the Ultimate Generation—will take a turn for the worse.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: With our valiant trio whittled down to two, I can only imagine my foes will have me surrounded.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But alas, this is fate. All we can do is wait, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh… So… what you've been waiting for is…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: An awakening. The long-awaited arrival of a certain heroine before me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O… Opera… O!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I understand! Please, watch me as I run!
